title: Regularity and coordinate intersections on a permissible blowup chart
statement:
Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a regular local ring [def-weil-regular-scheme] with a regular system of parameters $t_1,\ldots,t_d$. Fix $1\le r\le d$, a nonempty subset $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,d\}$ with $J\cap\{1,\ldots,r\}\ne\varnothing$, and a subset $I\subseteq\{1,\ldots,r\}$. For $j\in J$, the standard chart of the blowup [def-nagata-global-blowup] of the ideal $(t_i:i\in J)$ is
$$A_j=R[ u_i\mid i\in J\setminus\{j\} ]/(t_i-t_j u_i\mid i\in J\setminus\{j\}),$$
with $u_i=t_i/t_j$; it is regular. If $B=V(t_1\cdots t_r)$, the reduced inverse image [def-weil-pbc-scheme-reduction] of $B$ on this chart is the union of the coordinate hyperplanes $t_j=0$, $u_i=0$ for $i\in(J\setminus\{j\})\cap\{1,\ldots,r\}$, and $t_k=0$ for $k\in\{1,\ldots,r\}\setminus J$. At every point these hyperplanes have local equations among a regular system of parameters; every intersection of a subset of them is empty or regular and has codimension equal to the size of the subset. If $M=V(t_i:i\in J)$ and $H=V(\prod_{i\in I}t_i)$ (empty product means $H=\varnothing$), the reduced inverse image of $H\cup M$ is the union of the exceptional hyperplane $t_j=0$ and the strict transforms [def-nagata-strict-transform] of the components $V(t_i)$, $i\in I$. On this chart the strict transform of $V(t_i)$ is the coordinate hyperplane $u_i=0$ if $i\in J\setminus\{j\}$, is empty if $i=j$, and is the coordinate hyperplane $t_i=0$ if $i\notin J$. Scheme-theoretic intersections and codimension use [def-weil-closed-immersion] and [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring].

source.place: Expose VIII, Lemma 4.2.9 coordinate-chart proof, printed p. 121

mathlib_searches.query: In a regular local coordinate chart, blowing up an ideal generated by a subset of parameters gives regular affine charts and the reduced total transform of coordinate hyperplanes is a normal crossings divisor; a strict coordinate sub-boundary plus the exceptional divisor is strict normal crossings.
mathlib_searches.results: Search returned smoothness and standard-smoothness declarations; no blowup chart or normal-crossings theorem.

mathlib_searches.query: Blowing up an ideal generated by part of a regular system of parameters has regular charts; strict transforms and exceptional coordinate hyperplanes meet regularly with expected codimension.
mathlib_searches.results: Returned smooth chart, Krull-dimension and regular-sequence declarations, but no blowup or boundary theorem.
